comment: trap.c immune_to_trap() for the hero's paranoid_confirmation:trap question (hack.c 2553-2561). A fire-resistant Valkyrie (ring of fire resistance) whose only burnable item is a scroll of fire she has identified by reading another steps back onto a seen fire trap: the known scroll is skipped (2913-2915) and the trap counts as hidden-immune, so she is asked. Polymorphed into an iron golem, she tries to step back onto a seen rust trap, which is never harmless to an iron golem (2880-2881), and declines.
